failure.name: Python / Lua / app bundle (arm64)
failure.detail: macOS Python runtime staging rejected the cached zstd bottle metadata: its runtime dependency receipt for lz4 differed from the selected installed dependency receipt across the available arm64 bottle manifests.
failure.precedingValidation: Build and required Python, Lua, persistence, and settings regression steps passed before installation.

implementation.change: Run an explicit quiet brew update before dependency discovery so the formula/API snapshot used to resolve the graph matches the bottle metadata downloaded for the subsequent force-bottle reinstall.
implementation.safety: The refresh is CI-only under the existing installer guard. Bottle-only installation, exact provenance validation, and fail-closed runtime staging remain enabled.

decision: Keep P8 packaging and platform qualification open until checks complete on the current PR head. This workflow fix does not establish native CAD compatibility or DWG/DXF support.
